title: PlayerHat
description: A mod that allows players to wear any item on their head.
body:
# PlayerHat
[简体中文](https://github.com/chenjunfu2/PlayerHat/blob/master/README.md)  
A mod that allows players to wear any item on their head.  
Simply equip any item in the helmet slot just like a regular helmet.  

**How it works:**  
Uses Mixin to remove the helmet-only restriction from the head equipment slot.
